title: Single-cell multiomics reveals the oscillatory dynamics of mRNA metabolism and chromatin accessibility during the cell cycle.
authors: Nariya, Maulik K; Santiago-Algarra, David; Tassy, Olivier; Cerciat, Marie; Ye, Tao; Riba, Andrea; Molina, Nacho
one_liner_zh: 该文结合单细胞多组学、生物物理建模和深度学习，量化细胞周期中mRNA代谢与染色质可及性动态，并涉及转录因子结合足迹分析，虽非聚焦TF-DNA结合机制建模，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The cell cycle is a tightly regulated process that requires precise temporal expression of thousands of cell-cycle-dependent genes. However, the genome-wide dynamics of mRNA metabolism throughout the cell cycle remain uncharacterized. Here, we combined single-cell multiome sequencing, biophysical modeling, and deep learning to quantify rates of mRNA transcription, splicing, nuclear export, and degradation. Our approach revealed that both transcriptional and post-transcriptional processes exhibit distinct oscillatory waves at specific cell cycle phases, with post-transcriptional regulation playing a prominent role in shaping mRNA accumulation. We also observed dynamic changes in chromatin accessibility and transcription factor binding footprints, identifying key regulators underlying the oscillatory dynamics of mRNA. Taken together, the results of our approach uncovered a high-resolution map of RNA metabolism dynamics and chromatin accessibility, offering new insights into the temporal control of gene expression in proliferating cells.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期是一个受到严格调控的过程，需要数千个细胞周期依赖性基因的精确时序表达。然而，整个细胞周期中mRNA代谢的全基因组动态仍未得到表征。在此，我们结合单细胞多组学测序、生物物理建模和深度学习，量化了mRNA转录、剪接、核输出和降解的速率。我们的方法揭示了转录和转录后过程在特定细胞周期阶段表现出不同的振荡波，其中转录后调控在塑造mRNA积累中发挥重要作用。我们还观察到染色质可及性和转录因子结合足迹的动态变化，识别了mRNA振荡动态背后的关键调控因子。综合来看，我们的方法结果绘制了RNA代谢动态和染色质可及性的高分辨率图谱，为增殖细胞中基因表达的时序控制提供了新见解。
